name: ring-bases
cmd: set -e; for side in main parent; do mkdir -p "$side"; tar -xf "replay-input/$side.tar" -C "$side"; (cd "$side" && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null); echo MODE=$side; (cd "$side" && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 taskset -c 0-3 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/run.ts --only ring_leader_election --skip given,broken --ms 60000); done
